papers.title_en: Exponentially Consistent Low Complexity Tests for Statistical Sequence Matching
papers.evidence: 统计序列匹配方法可支持宏基因组测序数据分析
papers.tldr: 统计序列匹配问题中，两个数据库各自包含多条独立同分布序列，需识别出分布相同的所有匹配对。现有测试依赖穷举搜索，复杂度高且难以实用。本文设计低复杂度固定长度测试，计算所有跨库序列对的得分，将得分足够小的对判定为匹配，并证明指数一致性。进一步提出序贯测试，利用阈值控制停止时间，性能严格优于固定长度测试。结果推广至未知匹配数情形，给出错误概率指数衰减率界，为实际应用提供更优复杂度性能权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Towards practical applications of statistical sequence matching, we propose low complexity tests that are exponentially consistent and bound the exponential decay rates for error probabilities of our proposed tests. In statistical sequence matching, one is given two databases of multiple sequences, where in each database, each sequence is generated i.i.d. from a distinct distribution. A pair of sequences, one from each database, is said matched if they are generated from the same distribution. The number of matched pairs of sequences, a.k.a, the number of matches, can be either zero or positive. We consider both cases of known and unknown number of matches. When the number of matches is known and positive, the task is to identify all matched pairs of sequences. To construct fixed-length tests, we calculate the scoring function values for all pairs of sequences across the two databases and identify the matched pairs as those having small enough pairwise scoring function values. We show that our proposed test is exponentially consistent, which strikes a better tradeoff between complexity and performance than existing fixed-length tests that use exhaustive search. To construct sequential tests, we need an additional positive threshold to determine the stopping time, and we show that our sequential test achieves strictly better performance than our fixed-length test. Subsequently, we generalize our results to the case with unknown number of matches.
